title: Stoke Newington Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in centres, hazards, and essential supplies in Stoke Newington.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. 24-Hour Emergency Hospitals (A&E):
- Homerton University Hospital: Homerton Row, E9 6SR. From Stoke Newington station: ~30 min walk southeast via Rectory Road, Downs Road, and Kenworthy Road (approx 1.5 miles), or bus 106 or 253 to Hackney Central, connecting to bus 242.
- Whittington Hospital: Magdala Avenue, Archway, N19 5NF. From Stoke Newington Church Street: bus 393 west towards Camden, or bus 106 to Finsbury Park then bus 210/W7 towards Archway.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- City and Hackney Urgent Treatment Centre: Homerton University Hospital, Homerton Row, E9 6SR.
- Whittington Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Magdala Avenue, N19 5NF.

3. Local Hazards & Infrastructure:
- New River channel passes west of the area near Green Lanes: localized open-water hazard.
- Surface water runoff risk exists in topographic depressions along Stoke Newington Church Street and adjacent to Abney Park Cemetery during cloudburst rainfall.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
- Multiple pharmacies and major grocers along Stoke Newington Church Street and Stoke Newington High Street (A10) provide emergency first-aid products, baby formula, water, and shelf-stable foods.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible (verify locally).
